meta.title: 2026 Aggregate Fantasy Draft Rankings - 12-team half-PPR, Season 22
meta.scoring: 0.5 PPR, 4pt pass TD, 25 yds/passing pt, -2 INT, -2 fumble lost
meta.player_pool: QB/RB/WR/TE only - this league has NO kicker and NO defense slots

sources.name: Fantasy Football Calculator 12-team half-PPR redraft ADP
sources.why: Exact format match and the most current market read.

sources.name: Rotoworld / NBC Sports Top 200 expert rankings
sources.why: Human expert judgment; reacts to news faster than ADP. Note their team labels are stale in places (they still list A.J. Brown on PHI and Deebo Samuel as a free agent).

sources.why: Second independent market. Down-weighted because best ball inflates QB/TE and upside rookies, and it predates the Aug 30 Josh Jacobs news.

meta.method: Each source converted to a rank, blended on the weights above, then adjusted for (a) this league's roster structure and (b) news that postdates one or more sources. A soft penalty is applied at half weight when a source omits a player rather than dropping the signal.

draft_mechanics.explanation: Round 1 runs 1->12, round 2 runs 12->1, and round 3 ALSO runs 12->1 instead of flipping back. Normal snake resumes in round 4. The practical effect is that the reversal transfers value toward the back of round 1: slot 12 picks at 12, 13 and 25, while slot 1 picks at 1, 24 and 36.
draft_mechanics.implication_early_slot: From slots 1-3 you get one elite player and then a 23-pick gap before your next two picks come almost together. Take the best player available at 1.01 and plan to pair two of the same position at the 2/3 turn.
draft_mechanics.implication_late_slot: From slots 10-12 you get three picks inside the top 25. That is the strongest position in this format - you can leave round 3 with two RB1s and a WR1, or lock an elite TE plus two backs.

structural_notes: NO KICKERS AND NO DEFENSES. roster_positions contains zero K and zero DST slots and enforce_position_limits is on, so those picks are unavailable and would be wasted anyway. Every other team in a normal league burns 2 of 15 picks there; here nobody does. This ranking contains only QB/RB/WR/TE. Do not draft a kicker or a defense under any circumstances.
Only 156 total picks. Anything past roughly rank 160 here will not be drafted, so late-round targets should be genuine upside swings, not depth.

One QB, 12 teams, 4-point passing TDs. Twelve starting QBs for twelve teams means the 12th-best QB is free. Waiting on QB is materially correct in this format. Rushing quarterbacks gain extra value because rush yards score at 10 yards per point versus 25 for passing yards.

One TE, no TE premium. Same logic as QB: there is a real cliff after the top two, but TE7 through TE14 are close to interchangeable. Either pay for Bowers/McBride or wait a long time - the middle is the trap.
Six bench spots and no K/DST to stash means every bench slot is live RB/WR upside. Handcuffs to your own starting RBs and high-variance receivers are worth more here than in a 15-round league.
Half PPR (0.5) sits between formats: pass-catching backs and slot receivers gain over standard scoring but not as much as full PPR. Do not import full-PPR rankings wholesale.
Replacement level: with 2RB + 2WR + 1 FLEX across 12 teams, roughly RB30 and WR30 are the waiver baseline. Value a player against that line, not against RB1.

draft_day_plan.core_principle: Overall value declines smoothly here - there is no single cliff to game. The cliffs that ARE real are positional: after the top 2 TEs, after roughly RB22, and after roughly WR34. Draft against those, not against the overall list.
draft_day_plan.rounds_1_3: Take the best available RB/WR. With only 2RB/2WR/1FLEX you need four to five genuinely startable RB/WR, and this is the only place to get them. Do not take a QB. Take a TE only if Bowers or McBride falls to you.
draft_day_plan.rounds_4_7: Keep hammering RB/WR. This is where the FLEX spot and your first bench pieces get filled. If you missed the top 2 TEs, Loveland or Tyler Warren here is fine value; otherwise keep waiting.
draft_day_plan.rounds_8_10: Take your one QB. QB8 through QB13 are separated by very little and any of them starts all season. If you have not taken a TE, take one now - the TE7-TE15 range is effectively interchangeable.
draft_day_plan.rounds_11_13: Pure upside. No kickers, no defenses, so every one of these picks is a live RB/WR swing. Prioritise (a) the direct backup to your own starting RBs and (b) receivers with a path to volume if someone ahead of them misses time.

players.name: Puka Nacua
players.note: Led the NFL with 129 catches and 1,715 yards in 2025. Not suspended and expected to play Week 1, but remains under active NFL Personal Conduct Policy review - an in-season suspension is possible at any point.

players.name: Ashton Jeanty
players.note: Low ankle sprain Aug 23, has not practiced since. Raiders 'optimistic' for Sep 13 but unconfirmed, and Washington has carved out a role regardless.

players.name: MarShawn Lloyd
players.note: Lead Green Bay back with Jacobs on the exempt list. Only 7 career touches and an injury history, but the touches are there now. Biggest post-cutdown riser.

players.name: Jonathon Brooks
players.note: Still an injury-return question mark; sources are split.

players.name: Sam LaPorta
players.note: Carrying an injury question into Week 1; ADP standard deviation is among the widest at the position.

players.name: Deebo Samuel Sr.
players.note: Rotoworld still lists him as a free agent while both ADP feeds have him in San Francisco - verify his status before drafting.

players.name: Josh Jacobs
players.note: On NFL Commissioner's Exempt List since Aug 30 - cannot practice or play, no timetable. Misdemeanor battery charges; court date Sep 10. Zero Week 1 value.

players.name: Mike Washington Jr.
players.note: Rookie 4th-rounder running with the ones while Jeanty is out. Kubiak has said he expects Washington involved even when Jeanty is healthy.

players.name: Travis Hunter
players.note: Has collapsed to WR60-65 across every source. Treat as a bench flier only.

players.name: Kaleb Johnson
players.note: Acquired by Green Bay from Pittsburgh on Aug 30, the same day Josh Jacobs was placed on the exempt list. Appears in no published ranking yet. Not a draft pick in 13 rounds - make him your first waiver claim if he takes the early-down work.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: Falling in both ADP feeds over the last two weeks.

players.name: Oronde Gadsden II
players.note: Working behind both Charlie Kolar and David Njoku in preseason. Route share was already thin; now looks undraftable in a 13-round league.
